_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：直說語氣 vs 虛擬語氣的區辨（eng.t_adv.subj.indicative-vs-subjunctive，學測／分科級）。真實／開放條件用直陳（If + 現在式, will）；與事實相反用虛擬（If + 過去式, would + 原形／If + 過去完成式, would have p.p.）。高階以句意是否『可能發生』鎖定要用直陳或虛擬，防把真實條件誤判成虛擬、或反之。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: 直說語氣 vs 虛擬語氣的區辨
units.can_do: 我能分辨句子要用直說語氣（真實、可能發生的條件）還是虛擬語氣（與事實相反的假設），並依句意選對動詞形式。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 直說 vs 虛擬
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The indicative (real/open condition) describes something possible or likely: 'If + present simple, ... will + base': If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
claims.verification_ref: 真實／開放條件＝直陳 If ＋ 現在式, will ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The subjunctive for something contrary to the PRESENT uses 'If + past simple, ... would + base': If I were you, I would apologize.
claims.verification_ref: 與現在相反＝虛擬 If ＋ 過去式, would ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The subjunctive for something contrary to the PAST uses 'If + past perfect, ... would have + past participle': If I had known, I would have told you.
claims.verification_ref: 與過去相反＝虛擬 If ＋ 過去完成式, would have ＋ 過去分詞；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The clue is meaning: if the situation is possible, use the indicative; if it is imagined and opposite to the facts, use the subjunctive (backshifted tense).
claims.verification_ref: 判準＝句意是否可能發生：可能→直陳；與事實相反→虛擬（時態後移）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The indicative mood states real facts and possible conditions. For a condition that may truly happen, use 'If + present simple, ... will + base form': 'If it rains, we will stay home.' This is open and possible.
teach.zh_hint: 直說語氣陳述真實的事實與可能發生的條件。對「可能真的發生」的條件，用 If ＋ 現在式, will ＋ 原形：If it rains, we will stay home。這是開放、可能的情況。

teach.body: If I study hard, I will pass the exam.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我用功，我就會通過考試。真實可能的條件→直說語氣（現在式, will）。

teach.body: The subjunctive mood imagines something opposite to the facts, and it shifts the tense back. For the present-unreal, use 'If + past simple, ... would + base': 'If I were you, I would apologize.' For the past-unreal, use 'If + past perfect, ... would have + past participle.' The clue is meaning: possible = indicative, imagined/opposite = subjunctive.
teach.zh_hint: 虛擬語氣想像「與事實相反」的情況，並把時態往後移。與現在相反用 If ＋ 過去式, would ＋ 原形：If I were you, I would apologize。與過去相反用 If ＋ 過去完成式, would have ＋ 過去分詞。判準是句意：可能發生→直說；想像／相反→虛擬。

teach.body: If I were taller, I would play basketball better.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我更高，我籃球會打得更好。（但我沒那麼高）與現在事實相反→虛擬語氣（過去式, would ＋ 原形）。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（真實可能的條件）：If it ____ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.（如果明天下雨，我們就取消野餐——明天真的有可能下雨）

distractor_rationales.rained: 主句是 will cancel（直說，真實可能），if 子句要用現在式 rains，不是過去式 rained（那是與現在相反的虛擬）。
distractor_rationales.had rained: had rained 是過去完成式，用於與過去相反的虛擬；此處是真實可能的未來。
distractor_rationales.would rain: would 不放進 if 子句；真實條件的 if 子句用現在式 rains。

practice.feedback: 真實可能的條件用直說：If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（與現在事實相反）：If I ____ you, I would tell the truth.（如果我是你，我會說實話——但我不是你）

distractor_rationales.am: 主句是 would tell（虛擬，與現在相反），if 子句用過去式 were，不是現在式 am（那是直說）。
distractor_rationales.will be: will 不用在與事實相反的假設；與現在相反的 if 子句用 were。
distractor_rationales.had been: had been 是過去完成式，用於與過去相反；此處是與現在相反，用 were。

practice.feedback: 與現在事實相反用虛擬：If I were you, I would tell the truth。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（與過去事實相反）：If I had known you were sick, I ____ visited you.（如果我當時知道你生病，就會去探望你了）

distractor_rationales.would: if 子句用過去完成式 had known（與過去相反），主句要用 would have ＋ 過去分詞，不是 would ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.will have: will 不用在與事實相反的假設；與過去相反的主句用 would have。
distractor_rationales.had: had visited 是過去完成式，用在 if 子句；主句用 would have visited。

practice.feedback: 與過去事實相反用虛擬：If I had known, I would have visited you。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句用的是直說語氣（陳述真實、可能發生的條件）？
practice.answer: If you water the plant, it will grow.
options: If you water the plant, it will grow.
If I were a bird, I would fly away.
If she had studied, she would have passed.
If he were here, he would help us.

were ＋ would ＋ 原形是虛擬語氣（與現在事實相反，人不可能是鳥）。
distractor_rationales.If she had studied, she would have passe: had p.p. ＋ would have p.p. 是虛擬語氣（與過去事實相反）。
were ＋ would 是虛擬語氣（與現在事實相反，他其實不在）。

practice.feedback: 真實、可能發生的條件用直說（If ＋ 現在式, will ＋ 原形）：If you water the plant, it will grow（澆水它就會長，真的有可能）。其餘三句都是與事實相反的虛擬語氣。

practice.stem: 判斷是真實可能還是與事實相反，並填對：這是真實可能的條件——'If we ____ (leave) now, we ____ (catch) the train.'（如果我們現在出發，就會趕上火車——真的有可能）
practice.answer: If we leave now, we will catch the train.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：真實可能→直說：If we leave now, we will catch the train（現在式, will ＋ 原形）。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評）：真實條件句語氣平穩；虛擬句的 were／would 稍強調，傳達『想像、與事實相反』。

lines.text: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
lines.intonation: if 子句後略停、will stay 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: If I were you, I would apologize right now.
lines.intonation: were 稍強調、would apologize 清楚、句尾下收
